The number of refresh rates a display supports at a size. A size is often available at 60 Hz and at higher rates such as 120 or 144 Hz. Use [RefreshRateAt](RefreshRateAt) to get them. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no way to ask for more than the main display.

```blitzbasic
d = PrimaryDisplay()
w = DisplayWidth(d)
h = DisplayHeight(d)
For r = 1 To CountRefreshRates(d, w, h)
	Print w + " x " + h + " is possible at " + RefreshRateAt(d, w, h, r) + " Hz"
Next
WaitKey
```
@param display  The display number, from 1 to [CountDisplays](CountDisplays).
@param width  The width in pixels of the size.
@param height  The height in pixels of the size.
@returns The number of refresh rates, or 0 if the display does not exist or does not have the size.
@gap A display number that does not exist gives 0 (an empty text for the name) instead of stopping the program, because a display can be unplugged while the program runs.
